content: permit (principal, action in [Action::"list", Action::"read"], resource) when { context.roles.containsAny(["reader", "editor", "admin", "platform-admin"]) };
permit (principal, action in [Action::"create", Action::"update"], resource) when { context.roles.containsAny(["editor", "admin", "platform-admin"]) };
permit (principal, action == Action::"delete", resource) when { context.roles.containsAny(["admin", "platform-admin"]) };
forbid (principal, action, resource) when { !(context.roles.contains("platform-admin")) && (context.tenant == "" || context.tenant != context.resource_tenant) };
forbid (principal, action, resource) when { context.environment != "dev" && context.environment != "staging" && context.environment != "prod" };
forbid (principal, action in [Action::"create", Action::"update"], resource) when { context.environment == "prod" && !(context.roles.containsAny(["admin", "platform-admin"])) };

id: deletes in prod are restricted to platform-admin
